name: Graceful Sensor Degradation
limitations: Fallback target -0.4 is a tested scenario-specific proposed control and is not a generally safe frequency.
Permanent shared-root loss with no surprise fails coherence criterion. Preserve counterexample.
Delayed/synthetic observations share one underlying deterministic model and are not three independent physical witnesses.
Recovery still uses ideal oscillator state to calculate residual; model error and real sensor faults untested.
No physical actuation, actual energy, nuclear fusion or fundamental forces implemented.
Source-root distinctness is asserted by simulation, not cryptographically verified.
